Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Claudia Torres DBA Revolve Impact / Elect Justice to host a Food Giveaway & Ballot

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Dynise Espeleta DBA Upside Crenshaw Holding, LLC to host a Drive – In Movie at

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Teresa Estrada DBA City of Inglewood (Parks and Recreation) to host a Halloween
  Spooktacular Event at 100 E. Manchester Blvd (Grevillea Art Park) on Friday,

  (Activity No.00299458)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Anthony Holt DBA Pull Up Neighbor Foundation to host a Pull Up Neighbor Grab
  and Go at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr Park (Parking Lot) on Saturday,

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #5:  Tracy Yeager DBA Greater Deliverance Church to host a Thanksgiving Outreach

  Saturday, November 21, 2020 from 11:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. (Activity No.00297878)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
